simulation.note: game.update(dt) with a fixed dt, game.netSync() at netSyncTps, like survev's game process

randomModes.seeded: Math.random = mulberry32(seed); used for game creation (map generation) and natural-randomness runs
randomModes.centered: Math.random() = 0.5: zero spread deviation, zero shotgun pellet jitter, bullet distAdj index 8 (0 m), headshot roll fails
randomModes.low: Math.random() = 0: deviation -spread/2, pellet jitter -jitter, bullet distAdj index 0 (-1 m)
randomModes.high: Math.random() = 1 - 2^-53: deviation +spread/2, pellet jitter +jitter, bullet distAdj index 16 (+1 m)

verification.check: ids whose survev def differs from ours after the patch

params.random: centered: zero spread deviation and pellet jitter, every pellet flies along the aim line
params.headshot: never for every gun; always (headshotChance = 1) for the headshot subset
params.target: 100 HP test player, no perks, no boost, standing still; armor sets helmetN + chestN
params.distance: centre-to-centre metres between shooter and target (both radius 1)
params.ttk: seconds from the end of the tick of the first shot to the end of the tick the target died
params.damagePerHit: applied damage of one pellet/bullet hit after falloff and armor, measured on a probe target whose health cap was raised to 10000 so it is never clamped
params.shotsToKill: shots fired no later than (death tick - bullet flight ticks)
params.trigger: auto/burst: held; single: spam-clicked every tick; magazine reloads happen if needed

notes: falloff uses the bullet's distanceTraveled at the end of the tick it hits (bullet.ts), not the exact contact point
outOfRange: the probe shot never reached the target (bullet distance shorter than the gap)
